definitions.explanation: A young cat, typically under one year old.

examples.japanese: {仔猫|こねこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
{仔猫|こねこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毛糸|けいと}→毛糸：00212_keito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The kitten is playing with yarn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道端|みちばた}→道端：28126_michibata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{迷|まよ}い→迷う：02426_mayou⟧{仔猫|こねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}って→拾う：00845_hirou⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I picked up a stray kitten on the roadside and brought it home.

notes:
Refers to a young cat. The kanji {仔|こ} specifically means "young animal," distinguishing this from {子猫|こねこ}, which uses the more general ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child). Both spellings are common, but {子猫|こねこ} is seen more frequently in everyday writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{迷|まよ}い→迷い：19437_mayoi⟧{仔猫|こねこ}: stray kitten
- {仔猫|こねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to pick up a kitten
- {仔猫|こねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise a kitten
- {仔猫|こねこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{里親|さとおや}→里親：21054_satooya⟧: adoptive family for a kitten

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧: cat (general term for cats of any age)
- ⟦{子犬|こいぬ}→子犬：19393_koinu⟧: puppy (the canine equivalent)
